node.title: Re^2: Lost in DateTime !
node.author: Discipulus
node.doctext:
..indeed i arrived to a similar conclusion, but slowly.. removing the +02 the conversion was made as expected: ie the +02 is the timezone hour modification

perl -MDateTime -e "@dtarg{qw(year month day hour minute second)}=split/[\s:-]/,'2017-06-10 21:55:00';$dt=DateTime->new(%dtarg); print scalar localtime($dt->epoch)" Sat Jun 10 23:55:00 2017

L*

There are no rules, there are no thumbs..
Reinvent the wheel, then learn The Wheel; may be one day you reinvent one of THE WHEELS.
